German Garden Nature Words: A1 Vocabulary Exercises

Learn Baum, Blume, Blatt and Gras in simple German garden sentences. Practise articles and plural forms with translations and explained A1 vocabulary tasks.

Try the exercisesWrite your own sentence

Vocabulary and usage

Learn der Baum (Bäume), die Blume (Blumen), das Blatt (Blätter) and das Gras. Baum is a tree, Blume a flower, Blatt a leaf in this garden context and Gras grass. Gras is usually treated as a mass noun in everyday descriptions; Blatt also has other meanings, such as a sheet of paper.

Common mistake to avoid

The plural leaves is Blätter in this context, not Blatten. A sheet and a leaf can both be ein Blatt, so the surrounding nouns matter.

How to practise: read the examples once, cover the English meanings and try explaining the choice aloud. Next, complete all four questions before opening their answers.

Four German examples with English meanings

Notice each word’s meaning, article and common word partners in context.

Worked example 1Der Baum neben dem Teich spendet Schatten.The tree next to the pond provides shade.
Worked example 2Eine gelbe Blume wächst zwischen den Steinen.A yellow flower grows between the stones.
Worked example 3Das einzelne Blatt fällt langsam auf den Weg.The single leaf slowly falls onto the path.
Worked example 4Nach dem Regen ist das Gras noch nass.After the rain the grass is still wet.

Practice: choose the matching word

Choose the word from the bank that matches the English cue and sentence. Use each item once; keep its spelling and capitalisation. Try each question before opening the answer. Where another answer is possible, the explanation notes it. These are self-check exercises, not exam scoring.

Word bank: Baum · Blatt · Blume · Gras

Question 1. Die Eiche ist ein großer ___. (tree)

Show answer and explanation for question 1

Answer: Baum

Baum is masculine and names a tree.

Question 2. Im Topf wächst eine rote ___. (flower)

Show answer and explanation for question 2

Answer: Blume

Blume is the flower growing in the pot.

Question 3. Am Zweig hängt noch ein grünes ___. (leaf)

Show answer and explanation for question 3

Answer: Blatt

Blatt means leaf in this branch-and-plant context.

Question 4. Die Wiese ist mit ___ bedeckt. (grass)

Show answer and explanation for question 4

Answer: Gras

Gras names the mass of grass covering the meadow.

Use it in your own sentence

Describe a flower growing beside a tree.

Try writing your answer before reading the model below. Other natural answers are possible.

One possible answer

Neben dem Baum wächst eine Blume im Gras.

Check your wording: Baum, Blume and Gras have different grammatical genders.

What to practise next

Recall the words without the bank. Use nouns with their articles and verbs with their usual sentence patterns, then write a new context.

Try the gaps again on another day without reading the explanation first. If a choice is still unclear, use the linked grammar foundation before moving to another topic.
